result_text:
I changed the two mock-folder rules in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java` (lines 393–394). The `*Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass, but I didn't write or run any tests for the new cases. I didn't check the example folders (`mock`, `mock.data`, `mock(old)`, `mock-größe`, `mock模拟`) or the negative ones (`remock/`, `demo/`, `mockery.java`) against the new regexes.

- **Change:** `.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` and `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` became `.*/__mock[^/\\]*/.*` and `.*/mock[^/\\]*/.*`. Any folder whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock` now matches, whatever follows. That covers a bare `mock/`, punctuation after `mock`, and non-ASCII characters.
- **Why it stays in one folder name:** the character class excludes `/` and `\`, so the match can't run past the folder name. The rule still needs a `/` before `mock`, so `remock/` and `demo/` don't match. Files like `mock.java` and `mockery.java` don't match either, because nothing follows the name that looks like a folder.
- **Old matches kept:** by the regex, `mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/` and `mockStore/` still match.
- **Backslash paths:** `SourceFileFilter.pathMatches` already also tries the path with `\` swapped for `/`, so Windows-style paths are covered without further change.
